title: Planning reproduces a story's premise before it joins a sprint
goal: The /kb-backlog plan step and kb/_self/backlog.md's Plan say that a story claiming current behaviour is wrong records, in its notes, a command that shows that behaviour now (a failing check or a tool run), and one whose premise does not reproduce is reshaped (to a test-only item or dropped) before a sprint commits it. Answers the SP-ar52y6fk failure: ST-qp5wsqab asked to change a gate that already judged the pushed range, and its worker found nothing to change.
